summary.text: JoJo Stewart is the Democratic candidate for Missouri House of Representatives District 154 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican incumbent Lisa Durnell.
Stewart also ran for the seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: JoJo Stewart was the Democratic candidate for Missouri House of Representatives District 154 in 2024, when Lisa Durnell defeated Stewart in the general election, 84.8 percent to 15.2 percent.
